title: Recovery of money appropriated through illegal charges
text: Recovery of money appropriated through illegal charges.— (1) If a sum of money has been appropriated in violation of provisions of this Act, the Government, following an investigation, as may be necessary, and by order in writing, may recover the said money from the concerned person, or may file a suit for compensation for the purpose of recovery. (2) The money recovered or collected under subsecti on (1) may be given to the aggrieved person.
source: Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013 (official English translation)
